analysis.summary: Fonebox Retail Limited reported its best financial performance in terms of revenue and net profit for the financial year ended March 31, 2025. The company generated a total income of Rs. 34,273.26 Lakh and a net profit after tax of Rs. 454.61 Lakh. Management intends to strengthen operations by focusing on expenditure reduction and aggressive domestic marketing.

margins_costs.claim: The company aims to improve profitability by reducing expenditures and increasing marketing efforts.
margins_costs.quote: Your Company looks forward to strengthen its operations by curtailing expenditure, aggressive domestic marketing etc. This would further help the Company to improve its results and profitability.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not recommend a dividend for FY25 to conserve resources for future growth.
capital_allocation.quote: With a view to conserve the resources for future prospect and growth of the Company, the Board of Directors of the Company have not recommended any dividend on equity shares for the financial year ended 31st March, 2025.

management_commitments.claim: The company appointed M/s. G K Kotecha & Associates as Secretarial Auditor for a five-year term.
management_commitments.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company, at its Meeting held on May, 21 2025, based on the recommendation of the Audit Committee, has, after considering and evaluating various proposals and factors such as independence, industry experience, technical skills, audit team, audit quality reports, etc. recommended the appointment of M/s. G K Kotecha & Associates, a peer reviewed firm of company secretaries in practice, to conduct Secretarial Audit and issue Secretarial Audit Report for a term of five (5) consecutive years from financial year April 1, 2025 up to March 31, 2030

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
